summary: Tidy up your chat history: delete old chats, clean up in one go, and keep chats with your projects.
notes: Chat history: each chat has a ⋯ menu to rename it, add it to a project, take it out, or delete it.
Select several chats to delete them or move them to a project together.
Clean up: delete every chat older than a week, a month, three months or a year. FBRX counts them first, and keeps chats that belong to a project unless you say otherwise.
Projects show how many chats they hold; "Chats" opens the history filtered to that project, and new chats started there stay with it.
Easter eggs now end on their own last line instead of a sign-off.
Help desk tickets no longer wait on a slow network lookup before they are sent.
